What niacinamide actually does inside your skin 🔬
Melanocytes make pigment and hand it up to the cells above. Niacinamide slows that handoff, so dark spots fade over time. Bonus: more ceramides, stronger barrier.
2–5% is enough. Give it 8 weeks.

It's a humectant: it pulls water into the top layer of your skin and holds it there, so skin looks plumper. Apply on damp skin, then seal with a moisturiser.

A living person's name. Names in red are traditionally linked to the dead, so it can feel like a bad omen. Use black or blue.
